hero.badge: National Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) • AI-GovTech Flagship
hero.title: Bridging Citizens & Governance through Intelligent AI
hero.subtitle: PROJECT SETU is an AI-powered digital governance platform that streamlines public service delivery, classifies grievances with automated SLA tracking, and delivers complete transparency to every citizen.

workflow.title: How SETU Transforms Grievance Redressal
workflow.subtitle: From submission to resolution, every step is automated, timed, and transparent.
workflow.step1Desc: Describe the problem in plain language with optional photo & GPS evidence.
workflow.step2Desc: Natural language classifier categorizes the issue, assesses urgency, and routes it directly to the jurisdictional authority.
workflow.step3Desc: Assigned field officer is bound by a statutory SLA timer with automated escalation triggers if unattended.
workflow.step4Desc: Officer uploads resolution evidence and the citizen receives instant SMS & in-app verification alerts.

features.title: Enterprise Government Infrastructure
features.feature1Desc: Full support across 12 scheduled Indian languages with instant switching and zero reload.
features.feature2Desc: Direct digital applications for certificates, utility connections, and trade licenses alongside official central portals.
features.feature3Desc: Discover 10+ verified central and state welfare entitlements with an interactive 60-second eligibility checker.
features.feature4Desc: AI companion providing step-by-step checklists, application tracking, and automated form prefilling.
